singleProposedCandidate.name: Prior-streak admission with a read-only boolean key check and baseline late interning
singleProposedCandidate.objective: Keep the established interner source path unchanged while limiting additional prefix-selector key work to rows with an existing prior exact-content witness.
singleProposedCandidate.callerAdmission: Retain the existing original-lookback-positive arm. Add recent_content_match_streak != 0 only to the current new-pointer-admission arm, which already requires validated glossary reuse enabled, strict glossary validation, and a prior row.
singleProposedCandidate.strictSelectorAdmission: At the existing pre-glossary selector point, require nonnull glossary_witness, original parser-local lookback == 0, a prior row, nonnull key_escape_mask, and the read-only boolean key predicate. Keep the current first-prefix selection loop and shared full glossary proof unchanged.

booleanKeyPredicate.expressionArm: Compare the current expression with the previous completed row expression using the existing equal raw-token length in [2,34] and <=32 raw-body-byte equality. An exact match returns true immediately.
booleanKeyPredicate.readingArm: If expression matching fails, require nonempty current reading, current raw-token length in [3,34], and equal previous-reading token length. Reject reading raw-equal to the current expression, then compare current and previous reading bodies exactly.
booleanKeyPredicate.readingAliasProof: The strict string scanner has validated both current token extents and quote delimiters. Equal raw-token lengths plus equal bodies imply equal raw tokens. The reading arm is already bounded to <=32 body bytes, so this alias exclusion can compare bounded bodies too. Empty reading remains excluded. The baseline late interner still computes its authoritative empty/equal-reading flag independently.
booleanKeyPredicate.unionSemantics: An expression match admits even when reading aliases expression. Only the reading-only arm excludes empty/raw-equal-to-expression reading. Semantically equal but raw-different escaped forms do not become raw aliases.
booleanKeyPredicate.writes: No metadata, key mask, interner IDs, heap bytes, cache state or policy state are written.
booleanKeyPredicate.bound: Each added byte-equality operation is bounded by the existing 32 raw-body-byte limit. No unbounded expression-reading comparison is added. Expression-first short circuit is logical OR evaluation, not a corpus-selected predicate.

singleProposedCandidate.lateInterner: Restore the baseline block verbatim, including independent reading alias computation, per-field adjacent bounded reuse, escape fallback, UTF-8/key decoding, hash/probe behavior and IDs. key_escape_mask carries only its baseline two escape bits.
sourceEditsRelativeToCurrentCandidate: Remove the four KEY_IDENTITY_CHECKED / KEY_READING_EQUALS_EXPRESSION / KEY_ADJACENT_EXPRESSION_MATCH / KEY_ADJACENT_READING_MATCH definitions.
Replace high-bit-producing adjacent_key_identity with the read-only boolean predicate.
Restore strict key_escape_mask assignment to its baseline two escape bits without early identity bookkeeping.
Call the boolean predicate from the existing pre-glossary prefix-selector guard, after current header grammar checks.
Add the sole prior-streak != 0 conjunct to the new pointer-admission arm; preserve the old positive-lookback arm.
Restore every late-interner hunk to the frozen baseline source.
Retain current parser-local first-candidate bounds, lookback-positive proof guard, caller original-lookback-only budget refill, and newest-content-witness reasoning.
singleProposedCandidate.unchangedInterfaces: No new parser parameter, exported ABI, option, metadata column, allocation or persistent state is required. The existing witness pointer carries admission.

The helper admits work only. Full bounded glossary byte equality alone authorizes grammar/hint reuse.

Scan at most the existing four prior records newest-first. Tag/rule lengths and first up-to-four-byte signatures select only the first candidate. No second attempt follows bounds, sample or full-equality failure.
Candidates longer than 511 bytes remain allowed when the immediately preceding glossary is short. Current logical-bank bounds remain authoritative.

Only original positive-lookback witnesses refill the original four-miss budget. Added selector witnesses never refill it. Existing exact full-content matching alone updates its original streak and four-match admission.

tradeoffAgainstOnlyAddingTheConjunct.oneConjunctOnly: Suppresses early identity evaluation outside the prior-streak gate, but retains current KEY_IDENTITY_CHECKED and adjacent-match flag logic in the late interner for all rows.
tradeoffAgainstOnlyAddingTheConjunct.proposedSingleCandidate: Removes that late-interner rewrite entirely, while repeating some bounded comparisons early and later on rows passing the prior-streak/original-lookback gate.
tradeoffAgainstOnlyAddingTheConjunct.scopeCorrection: The early predicate can run on 85,314 observed JMdict rows, not just the 44,466 key admissions; 40,848 predicates reject. Actual additional comparison bytes were not measured.
tradeoffAgainstOnlyAddingTheConjunct.inactivePathLimit: The new pointer/selector guard still exists. Restoring baseline interning removes its new high-bit processing, but does not establish zero overhead or a Jitendex improvement.
tradeoffAgainstOnlyAddingTheConjunct.missingCoverage: No successor Jitendex/VNDB gate counts were acquired. Zero original Jitendex prefix proofs does not prove that the successor early predicate would be inactive.
tradeoffAgainstOnlyAddingTheConjunct.attributionLimit: Source analysis cannot establish that the current candidate late-interner branches caused the reported Jitendex timing concern.
tradeoffAgainstOnlyAddingTheConjunct.decision: One source design for a later decision, composed before local-screen completion and unchanged by that result. Do not acquire both alternatives and select favorable timings. No implementation decision is made here.

mandatoryFutureQualification.allUniqueCaveat: All-unique rows have no prior exact-content streak. Existing unique/common-prefix/unequal-glossary negatives become inactive for the added selector. They remain parity and inactive-path controls, but cannot establish active futile-probe non-regression.

activeShortMiss.geometry: Use identical short raw expression keys, empty reading, headers and term tags. X_n is a valid 242-byte glossary; Y_n has equal length with a string-byte difference near the end outside the existing middle/tail samples. Each repeating block uses new content identities.
activeShortMiss.state: The second X_n establishes streak1 without original admission4. Y_n has original lookback0, passes key/prefix admission, selects adjacent X_n, passes samples and fails full equality. Its raw-content miss resets the streak.

activeOlderLongMiss.geometry: L_n/L_prime_n are valid 4096-byte glossaries with a late difference outside samples. S_n is short and repeats exact full content. A/B have distinct raw tag/rule prefixes; keys are short and identical.
activeOlderLongMiss.state: The final row has streak1 and original lookback0 because the immediate predecessor is short. The first matching prefix is L_n at distance3. Perform one bounded long proof and reject. Retain and count the old adjacent-long probe on the first S_n separately.
activeOlderLongMiss.companions: The same prelude must cover exact long success and current logical-bank bounds rejection with readable next-bank bytes. No new length cap is introduced.

activeFirstPrefixOnly.geometry: All glossaries short; H differs from Q outside samples; S repeats exact full content; keys short and equal.
activeFirstPrefixOnly.state: Final Q has streak1/original lookback0. H at distance3 is the first matching prefix and fails its full proof. Earlier Q at distance4 must not be tried. Ordinary downstream content dedup may find Q; there is no new glossary proof or original-budget refill.
